name: Out of Season
description: The eels stopped running past the drowned chapel in Harvest. Nesh has kept six huts standing through two months of weather to find out why.

stages.name: Go and look at the chapel
stages.description: It stands in the water at anything above summer level, and it is a long way above summer level.

objectives.description: Walk out to the Drowned Chapel.

stages.name: What is in the nave
stages.description: Something has been in the flooded nave long enough to have cleared the reach of everything else.

objectives.description: Deal with what is in the chapel.

stages.name: Tell Nesh
stages.description: She has been waiting two months to be told something.

objectives.description: Bring word back to the eel camp.
